controls.name: Scrolling List Field
controls.text:
MOVE
J X-2
L X+2
I Y-2
J Y+2

SCALE 
[ *1.02
] /1.02
 
ANGLE
1 Z-1
2 Z+1
3 Y-1
4 Y+1
5 X-1
6 X+1

ANGLE_MODIFIER
X fXrot +.10
Y fYrot +.10
Z fZrot +.10
SHIFT+X fXrot 0
SHIFT+Y fYrot 0
SHIFT+Z fZrot 0 

PIVOT
F X-2
H X+2
T Y-2
G Y+2
A Z-2
S Z+2
 
CAMERA
pad4 X-4
pad6 X+4
pad8 Y-4
pad2 Y+4
pad - Z-4
pad + Z+4

controls.name: Scrolling List Field
controls.text:
J MOVE_X.minus_2
L MOVE_X.plus_2
I MOVE_Y.minus_2
J MOVE_Y.plus_2
[ SCALE _.multiplied_1.02
] SCALE _.divided_1.02
1 ANGLE_Z.minus_1
2 ANGLE_Z.plus_1
3 ANGLE_Y.minus_1
4 ANGLE_Y.plus_1
5 ANGLE_X.minus_1
6 ANGLE_X.plus_1
X ANGLE_MODIFIER_fXrot .plus_.10
Y ANGLE_MODIFIER_fYrot .plus_.10
Z ANGLE_MODIFIER_fZrot .plus_.10
SHIFT.plus_X ANGLE_MODIFIER_fXrot 0
SHIFT.plus_Y ANGLE_MODIFIER_fYrot 0
SHIFT.plus_Z ANGLE_MODIFIER_fZrot 0
F PIVOT_X.minus_2
H PIVOT_X.plus_2
T PIVOT_Y.minus_2
G PIVOT_Y.plus_2
A PIVOT_Z.minus_2
S PIVOT_Z.plus_2
pad4 CAMERA_X.minus_4
pad6 CAMERA_X.plus_4
pad8 CAMERA_Y.minus_4
pad2 CAMERA_Y.plus_4
pad CAMERA_.minus_ Z.minus_4
pad CAMERA_.plus_ Z.plus_4
